texts: good. the maintenance reading comes through as a fireable generic about what Keepers do, plus the reified 'dim' state, its continuation tag and a per-lantern rule so an individual lantern still answers 'is it dim?'; the reviewer's one objection about the dimness being asserted too strongly was overruled on adjudication. Note only that 'at the Hollows' was attached to the lanterns (the lanterns that are at the Hollows), not to the keeping.
